entry.title: Welle 0.2.0
entry.summary: Welle 0.2.0: a Waldorf Wave emulation running the Wave OS, as an MPC instrument plugin for 64-bit MPCs (MPC Live III and other aarch64 models). **Install** - With the OpenMPC Plugin Manager: install Welle, then upload your Wave OS 1.700 files (`w2sys.bin`, `wdv.sys`) and any sound sets from the manager's web page ("Your files"). - By hand: unzip `Welle-0.2.0-VST2-Plugins.zip`, copy the folder into `VST2 Plugins` at the root of a drive, put `w2sys.bin` and `wdv.sys` in `Content/roms` and your sou
